description: This file defines the Inbox class used in Spark's RPC over Netty, managing message processing for RpcEndpoints including message queuing, thread safety, and error handling.

classes.name: Inbox
classes.description: Manages message queue and processing for an RpcEndpoint, ensuring thread safety and proper lifecycle handling.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes stored messages, handling different message types and invoking corresponding endpoint methods.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Adds a message to the inbox queue or drops it if the inbox is stopped.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the inbox, ensuring 'OnStop' is the last message and disables concurrent processing.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the message queue is empty.

methods.name: getNumActiveThreads
methods.description: Returns the number of active threads processing messages.
